verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the electrical acceptance condition that the power supply support both motors, solenoids, and fans simultaneously under load.
Target-specific implementation claim: the BOM was revised with a 50A adapter and higher-power PWM controllers to provide reserve capacity and reduce overheating risk.

The client approves the uniquely identified revised BOM, adopting the 50A power supply and higher-power controller configuration for adequate load capacity and overheating protection; no prior state keys become obsolete.
